title: Political party WhatsApp channels: an open dataset of parties' WhatsApp presence across Europe
description:
An open dataset of European political parties' presence on WhatsApp — their Channels, groups and click-to-chat numbers — with the public follower counts of their Channels tracked over time and ranked by city, region, country and continent.

Follower counts are read from each Channel's own public preview page (there is no API). Counts are recorded exactly when the source prints them exactly, and marked as rounded otherwise; a failed read is stored as a failure with its status, never as a zero. The dataset covers political parties and their territorial branches only — youth wings, parliamentary groups, campaigns and movements are out of scope.

The data ships as an append-only CSV of follower readings, a curated registry of parties (one JSON file per country), observed channel profiles, mirrored channel avatars, and ISO 3166 geography tables. Every figure comes from a public page; nothing is estimated, modelled or back-filled. A Frictionless datapackage.json describes every file.

This is a published copy of the dataset maintained in the wha.tools monorepo, and powers the ranking pages at wha.tools.
notes: Follower counts are read from WhatsApp's own public Channel preview pages, which are Meta's pages; see the README's methodology and terms sections. The dataset records political parties and their territorial branches only.
